description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeysCapabilities class, specifically testing the support for different key systems and their versions via IPC mock interfaces.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaKeysCapabilitiesKeySystemsTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing MediaKeysCapabilities related to key systems, setting up mock IPC interfaces and testing various scenarios.

methods.name: RialtoClientMediaKeysCapabilitiesKeySystemsTest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes mock IPC factory and MediaKeysCapabilities instance.

methods.name: GetSupportedKeySystemsSuccess
methods.description: Test that getSupportedKeySystems returns the expected list when IPC call succeeds.

methods.name: GetSupportedKeySystemsFailure
methods.description: Test that getSupportedKeySystems returns an empty list when IPC call fails.

methods.name: SupportsKeySystemSuccess
methods.description: Test that supportsKeySystem returns true when IPC call indicates support.

methods.name: SupportsKeySystemFailure
methods.description: Test that supportsKeySystem returns false when IPC call indicates no support.

methods.name: GetSupportedKeySystemVersionSuccess
methods.description: Test that getSupportedKeySystemVersion returns true and sets version when IPC call succeeds.

methods.name: GetSupportedKeySystemVersionFailure
methods.description: Test that getSupportedKeySystemVersion returns false when IPC call fails.
